h2_sections: The Hard Truth About Biblical Masculinity
What This Means For Your Life
key_points: Define biblical masculinity from biblical perspective (not cultural)
Address the main objection/excuse men have
Include at least one KJV verse with interpretation
Challenge comfortable Christianity on this topic
End with specific, actionable binary choice
biblical_angle: Approach 'biblical masculinity' from a confrontational, KJV-based perspective that challenges soft, mainstream Christianity and calls men to action.
voice_reminders: Confrontational, not soft - lead with challenge
Staccato rhythm - short paragraphs, fragments for punch
Working-man metaphors - garbage trucks, calloused hands
Binary endings - force a choice, no soft landings
